Title: Rishabh and the Family

Cast

1. Rishabh - 12 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Kavya - 8 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
3. Kavita - 39 years, mother
Look: green saree
4. Siya - 11 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
5. Aarav - 12 years, friend
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Rishabh stands in the park. Kavya, Kavita and Siya stand near him.]

Kavita: "Siya, what's the plan today?"

[Rishabh does push-ups.]

Rishabh (softly): "Hey, look at that!"

[Rishabh does yoga on a mat.]

Siya: "One more time!"

[Kavya skips rope.]

Siya: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
